_README: Post-deploy steps, keyed by SOURCE server name. When a package is built from
that server, this list is copied into manifest._meta.post_deploy. The deployer
runs each named TI process on the TARGET, in order, after the objects deploy
and before verification — the 'finish making the model work on this server'
Only put STRUCTURAL finishers here. Data loads (e.g. WFP Load Actuals) are
operational and stay out of the deploy.
Entry form: a bare process name string, or { "name": "X", "note": "why" }.

post_deploy.name: WFP Build YTD Hierarchy
post_deploy.note: belt-and-braces for the YTD alt-hierarchy on WFP Period (idempotent); remove once the packager is trusted to carry it and the process is deleted

post_deploy.name: WFP Reprocess Feeders
post_deploy.note: feeders must be reprocessed after any rules change
